story.fullStory:
Leann Rimes's "How Do I Live" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "How Do I Live" is a song written by Diane Warren.

"How Do I Live" is a song written by Diane Warren.
It was originally performed by American singer and actress LeAnn Rimes and was the first single from her second studio album, You Light Up My Life: Inspirational Songs (1997).
It also appeared on international editions of her follow-up album Sittin' on Top of the World (1998).
Margaret LeAnn Rimes Cibrian (née Rimes, born August 28, 1982) is an American singer, songwriter and actress.
She originally rose to success as a country music artist at the age of 13 and has since crossed over into pop, contemporary Christian, and other musical genres.
Rimes has placed more than 40 singles on international charts since 1996.
